_: A complete judgment.json: every run-level key present, every shape the validator insists on. Copy it, replace every value, keep every key. Findings are NOT in this file: each is its own file, <qa-root>/findings/<ID>.json, the shape of templates/finding.example.json, written the moment it is proven (`verdict-facts` names both templates and the directory). A finding you looked at and found unchanged goes in `still_open` by id (e.g. ["PRICER-F-2"]); one you looked at and found gone goes in `resolved` by id; a question may name the finding it is about (`"finding": "PRICER-F-3"`). `questions` are for a person to answer with `verdict-answer`; the next run reads the answer and never asks again. Values here are a made-up project (PRICER); nothing in them is a rule.

isolation_check.method: ls -a | grep -i '^\.env' -> none; git status --porcelain -> clean; grep -rn 'https\?://' src/ tests/ -> localhost only. No credential file, no service config, no database. Every experiment ran in a scratch copy under the session scratchpad; the checkout was never written to.
